verdict.rationale: The pack shows Sentry has a documented public API reference at docs.sentry.io/api/ and publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec. Nothing shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable "try it" examples. A static reference plus a machine-readable spec is only a building block that users could load into their own tools, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
